title: cinematic.skipped
description: M12C § Skip / pause / replay UX. Fires when the player skips a cinematic (Esc/Space past the 3000 ms confirm window on first-watched) OR when Sandbox storyteller suppresses cinematics entirely (`reason: sandbox_suppressed`, `skipped_at_ms: 0`). Pair with `cinematic.ended { was_skipped: true }` for replay parity.
